g_ir.name: pairwise_uniform_weight
g_ir.intuition: Construct all pairs where the first element is preferred over the second and assign a fixed, nonnegative uniform weight scaled by a configurable parameter weight_tau, ensuring simplicity and scale invariance in preference supervision.
